done_when: A temporary CBP extract with a valid header and evidence: "" produces exactly one checker problem; valid quoted evidence still verifies; existing no-evidence no-caption behavior is unchanged. The new regression fails before the parser fix and passes after.
goal: An explicitly empty quoted CBP evidence value (evidence: "") is currently ignored because CBP_EVIDENCE requires at least one character. Make this malformed quote fail closed, without changing behavior for records with no evidence line (e.g. no-captions outcomes).
scope_out: CBP store/repo; real rows/transcripts; policy for files with no evidence line; unrelated GPS ambiguity
steps: Add an isolated regression with a CBP header and explicit evidence: ""; confirm failure on current code.
Adjust only the CBP evidence parser so an empty quoted value reaches the existing fail-closed empty-normalization check.
Run focused verifier tests and quote-specific integration tests, then ship through sync.py.
title: verify_extract_quotes ignores explicitly empty CBP evidence
